fields.name: generation_type
fields.description:
Video generation mode (optional). Specifies different video generation approaches:

- **TEXT_2_VIDEO**: Text-to-video - Generate videos using only text prompts
- **FIRST_AND_LAST_FRAMES_2_VIDEO**: First and last frames to video - Flexible image-to-video generation mode
  - 1 image: Generate video based on the provided image
  - 2 images: First image as first frame, second image as last frame, generating transition video
- **REFERENCE_2_VIDEO**: Reference-to-video - Generate videos based on reference images, requires 1-3 images in imageUrls (minimum 1, maximum 3)

**Important Notes**:
- REFERENCE_2_VIDEO mode currently supports the veo3_fast and veo3_lite models.
- If not specified, the system will automatically determine the generation mode based on whether imageUrls are provided

fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.description:
Video aspect ratio. Specifies the dimension ratio of the generated video. Available options:

- 16:9: Landscape video format. 
- 9:16: Portrait video format, suitable for mobile short videos
- Auto: In auto mode, the video will be automatically center-cropped based on whether your uploaded image is closer to 16:9 or 9:16.

Default value is 16:9.

fields.name: image_urls
fields.description:
Provide an external image URL as a reference for video generation. Up to 7 images are supported. Do not use it simultaneously with task_id. In your prompt, reference an uploaded image by typing @image(n) followed by a space (for example: @image1 a sunset over the ocean).
- Supports JPEG, PNG, and WEBP formats
- Maximum file size for each image: 10MB
- The Spicy mode is not available when using external images
- The array can contain a maximum of seven URLs
- Only one is supported when the resolution is 1080p.

fields.name: task_id
fields.description:
Task ID from a previously generated Grok image. Use with index to select a specific image. Do not use with image_urls.

- Use task ID from grok-imagine/text-to-image generations
- Supports all modes including Spicy
- Maximum length: 100 characters

fields.name: index
fields.description:
When using task_id, the 0-based index of the image to use. A grok-imagine/text-to-image task returns 2 images, so valid values are 0 and 1. Default 0.

- Ignored if image_urls is provided

fields.name: prompt
fields.description:
Text prompt describing the desired video motion. Optional field.

- Should be detailed and specific about the desired visual motion
- Describe movement, action sequences, camera work, and timing
- Include details about subjects, environments, and motion dynamics
- Maximum length: 5000 characters
- Supports English language prompts

fields.name: mode
fields.description:
Specifies the generation mode affecting the style and intensity of motion. Note: Spicy mode is not available for external image inputs.

fields.name: upscale_factor
fields.description:
Upscale factor applied to both width and height, keeping the aspect ratio. Optional. Allowed values: `"1"`, `"2"`, `"4"`, `"8"` (numbers are also accepted). Default: `"2"`.

- `1`: same-size quality enhancement (denoise, sharpen, preserve text); dimensions do not change
- `2` / `4` / `8`: output width and height = input × factor
- Output must stay within 67 MP (about 8192×8192) and 16,384 px per side; otherwise the request is rejected with 422 and not charged
- Billing tier (2K / 4K / 8K) is determined by the total output pixels

fields.name: resolution
fields.description:
Output size tier. Optional, default `2K`; case-insensitive.

- `1K`: about 1 MP
- `2K`: about 4 MP
- `4K`: about 16 MP, the officially recommended quality tier
- Each image is billed by this tier, plus a charge for each reference image
- Do not pass together with `width`/`height`; with a custom size, billing follows its total pixels

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Random seed, 0–2147483647. Optional; a random seed is used when omitted, and the actual seed is returned with the result. With prompt expansion on, the rewritten prompt differs each time, so results are only reproducible when `expand_prompt` is `false`.

fields.name: expand_prompt
fields.description:
Whether to rewrite the prompt into a detailed English description before generating. Optional. Prompt expansion is on by default; we recommend keeping it on for better image quality.

- `true` (default, recommended): the prompt is rewritten into a detailed English description
- `false`: the prompt is used as-is

fields.name: output_format
fields.description: Output image format. Optional, default `png`. JPEG uses quality 95 and is much smaller; 4K PNG files are very large, so use JPEG when you need smaller files.

fields.name: image_urls
fields.description:

- 1–16 images, publicly accessible `http(s)://` URLs; the order defines `<Picture 1>`, `<Picture 2>`, …
- Each image ≤ 20 MB and ≤ 64 MP
- Supported formats: JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, BMP (transparent backgrounds are filled with white)

fields.name: width
fields.description:

- Total pixels (width × height) must be between 655,360 and 20,000,000, and width : height between 1:3 and 3:1
- The output is exactly this size
- Billing tier by total pixels: up to 1,200,000 → `1K`, up to 4,500,000 → `2K`, above → `4K` (e.g. 1920 × 1080 → `2K`, 3840 × 2160 → `4K`)

fields.name: height
